fails_if: the duplicate-row refusal compares something coarser than the whole record (say the semantic key alone), so two rows of one member that differ in a delivered cell are refused
note: The allowed twin: the same member in two rows that differ in one delivered cell (the unit), so the rows prepare to two record ids and the build completes.

sources.description: Register 1 delivers VALUE (member 1001) in two Registerinformation rows that differ only in the unit.
